name: Peter Parker Cry
look: Five stacked stills from Sam Raimi's Spider-Man films. J. K. Simmons as J. Jonah Jameson talks from his desk, Tobey Maguire as Peter Parker smiles hopefully, Jameson pauses with a straight face, then bursts out laughing, and the last panel is a close-up of Peter crying.
use: A hopeful request gets crushed. Jameson asks or says something, Peter answers hopefully, Jameson seems to consider it, then laughs in his face, and Peter ends up in tears. Text goes beside each face as dialogue.
examples: Yes sir, I've been working really hard
Me going back to my desk
